chunks: “The thigh is not part of the 'awrah.”

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْعَوْرَةِ: the private part or area that must be covered

ai.seo_question: Is the thigh considered part of the 'awrah in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام regarding the boundaries of the 'awrah. It states that the thigh is not considered part of the 'awrah, making it relevant to discussions of ritual purity, bathing, and covering.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.253 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'The thigh is not considered part of the 'awrah (private parts).'
